scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Good day, young one. I have the power to remove cards that you have compounded onto your equipment. Does this idea please you?
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
年轻人，你好。我有能力移除你装备上镶嵌的卡片。你愿意试试吗？

scripts.text: Yes, it does.
scripts.translation: 是的，我愿意。

scripts.text: What do you charge?
scripts.translation: 你需要什么报酬？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Very well. Which item shall I examine for you?
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
很好。你想让我检查哪件物品？

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Young one... Your not wearing anything there that I can remove cards from.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
年轻人...你身上并没有穿戴任何可以移除卡片的物品。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Young one... There are no cards compounded on this item. I can do nothing with it, I'm afraid.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
年轻人...这件物品上没有镶嵌任何卡片。恐怕我帮不了你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFJust a minute!
I can't offer any of my
services to you because
you're carrying too much
stuff. Put your extra items in
Kafra Storage and come again~
scripts.translation:
^3355FF请稍等！
因为你携带的物品过多，
我无法为你提供这项服务。
请将多余物品存入卡普拉仓库，
然后再来找我~

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
This item has {0} cards compounded on it. To perform my magic, I will need {1} zeny, a ^0000FFStar Crumb^000000, and a ^0000FFYellow Gemstone^000000.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
这件物品上镶嵌了{0}张卡片。施展法术需要{1} Zeny、一颗^0000FF星星的角^000000和一块^0000FF黄色魔力矿石^000000。

scripts.text: Very well. Do it.
scripts.translation: 很好，请开始吧。

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Very well. Return at once if you seek my services.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
很好。如果你需要我的服务，请随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
You do not have all the items I require to work my magic, child. Come again when you do.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
孩子，你还没有集齐我施展法术所需的全部材料。等你准备好了再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Before I begin, I must warn you--I may fail. If I do, I may destroy the cards, the item, or both. I do not give refunds. That being said, which is more important to you: The cards, or the item?
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
在开始之前，我必须提醒你——我可能会失败。如果失败，卡片、物品或两者都可能会被毁。我不提供退款。既然如此，对你来说更重要的是：卡片，还是物品？

scripts.text: I changed my mind about this.
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了。

scripts.text: The item.
scripts.translation: 物品。

scripts.text: The cards.
scripts.translation: 卡片。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Very well. Return at once if you seek my services.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
很好。如果你需要我的服务，请随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Very well. I shall begin.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
很好。我要开始了。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
The process was a total failure. I am afraid the item and the cards were destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
过程彻底失败了。恐怕物品和卡片都被毁掉了。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
While I have managed to remove the cards from the item, they were destroyed in the process. The item, however, is okay.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
虽然我从物品上移除了卡片，但卡片在过程中被毁掉了。不过，物品本身完好无损。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Most unfortunate. I succeeded at removing the cards, but the item itself was destroyed in the process.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
非常不幸。我成功移除了卡片，但物品本身在过程中被毁掉了。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
I have failed to remove the cards. Luckily, however, both the item and the cards are still okay.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
我没能移除卡片。不过幸运的是，物品和卡片都完好无损。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
The process was a success. Here are your cards and your item. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
过程很顺利。这是您的卡片和物品。再见。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
I charge a flat fee of {0} zeny, plus {1} zeny for each card I remove from the item. In addition, I need a star crumb and a yellow gemstone to work my magic.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
我的收费是固定的{0} Zeny，此外每移除一张卡片需要{1} Zeny。另外，施展魔法还需要星星的角和黄色魔力矿石。

scripts.text:
[Wise Old Woman]
Very well. Return at once if you seek my services.
scripts.translation:
[睿智的老妇人]
很好。如果你需要我的服务，请随时回来。
